summary: Iteration 3 backend testing complete. Added 14 new tests covering Web Push (VAPID public-key, subscribe RBAC, test-send shape), encrypted attachments (add/list/download roundtrip, 413 oversize, 404 missing, 403 cross-victim), government evidence export zip (zip media-type + Content-Disposition + metadata.json/complaint-english.txt/complaint-hindi.txt/narrative.txt/README.txt/attachments/*/audio.webm presence, 403 for other victim), and audit-log coverage for push_subscribe/attachment_add/attachment_download/export_pack. Full suite 38/38 passed with no regressions on seed, auth, SVI, cases, draft, counsellor queue sort, escalation, supervisor audit-log, support directory, and audio encryption/playback.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~855 lines; approaching 700-line split threshold — consider extracting push, attachments, export, and seed into separate routers for maintainability.
AttachmentCreate has no server-side ownership restriction on upload beyond victim-check — counsellor/supervisor can upload attachments to any case; acceptable but should be audit-reviewed.

Attachment download has no counsellor assignment check — any counsellor can download attachments for any case; mirrors existing audio endpoint comment from iteration 2. Consider restricting to assigned_counsellor_id or supervisor-only.
/push/test endpoint only tests subs owned by the caller (user_id filter); if a counsellor has not registered a subscription it will always return sent=0,subs=0 — intentional per agent note.

VAPID_PRIVATE_PEM_PATH is checked at request time inside send_push — if missing, pywebpush path is silently skipped and logged as warning. Confirmed /push/test still returns proper shape {ok,sent,subs}.
Export endpoint uses `iter([buf.getvalue()])` for StreamingResponse — fine for small zips but will buffer entire pack in memory; consider true chunked streaming for large evidence packs.

Attachment size limit uses len(data_b64) > 8_000_000 (~6 MB raw) — docstring/error message says 'max ~6 MB'; consider decoding before measuring for accuracy, or document that the limit is on b64 string length.
